task_text: Sample raster values at input feature locations, then calculate a derived attribute from the sampled values.
Merge multiple vector layers into one layer, then create buffer polygons around the merged features.
Add seven derived attributes in sequence using Python expressions, allowing each calculation to use fields created by earlier calculations.
Merge multiple vector layers, then keep only the required attribute fields in the combined result.
Clip vector features to a boundary, then convert any multipart results into singlepart features.
Create a polygon from the extent of a reference layer, then intersect another vector layer with that extent polygon.
Reproject polygon zones to the target coordinate system, then calculate raster statistics and append them to the reprojected zone attributes.
Reproject a vector layer into a different coordinate reference system.
